mapper.insert: insert into member (member_no, member_name, member_sex, member_age, member_tel, card_status, member_pwd, create_time) values (#{memberNo}, #{memberName}, #{memberSex}, #{memberAge}, #{memberTel}, #{cardStatus}, #{memberPwd}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update member set member_no = #{memberNo}, member_name = #{memberName}, member_sex = #{memberSex}, member_age = #{memberAge}, member_tel = #{memberTel}, card_status = #{cardStatus}, member_pwd = #{memberPwd} where member_id = #{memberId}
